description.value:
When everything falls apart, you have to do more—it may be your only chance to turn the tide.


Once per long rest, as a Desperate Action, immediately take an entire extra turn. At the end of this desperate turn, do not gain the @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.QUP5YUWBCXD17R7E]{Desperate} condition. However, you cannot take a desperate action until the end of your next turn.
Like any normal turn, this triggers any “on your turn” effects.
